title:
Listens to 'ITEM_CHANGE' and 'ROW_DELETED' actions on various form grids containing sensor rules.
When a rule is changed or deleted, this epic will update the summary section related to that form grid.
Also listens to 'Reliability.BulkDataPrepAppState.START_UI_WORKFLOW' and
'Reliability.DataPreparationApplicationState.START_UI_WORKFLOW' actions. This is so that the summary section
contents get cleared when the user starts a new workflow in case there was previous data.

Is expected to receive these arguments in the payload:
- 'summaryId' - The ID of the summary section which will be updated
- 'isExpectedSensorGrid' - Whether the sensor rules are for {@link ExpectedSensor}
name: UpdateDataPrepRuleSummaryEpic
